name: M3M Paragon57
summary: The project, M3M as developer, Sector 57 (Sushant Lok III), the RERA number GGM/651/383/2022/126, the ready status (an occupancy certificate is reported), the August 2026 marketed possession and a starting price around ₹1.25–1.4 Cr are confirmed. Our 1.5-acre land area conflicts with the 3.16 acres every source gives. Sources describe 4 retail levels, not 6 floors, and the reported RERA completion date is 30 June 2026.

checks.web: M3M Paragon 57, mixed-use commercial project in Sector 57, Gurgaon

checks.note: Our 'listed as' developer name is the project name, which is cosmetic.

checks.ours: Sushant Lok III, Sector 57, Sector 57, Gurugram, Haryana

checks.web: Ready to Move (Houssed); Partially Ready To Move (Square Yards); M3M reportedly received the occupancy certificate
checks.note: The occupancy certificate report comes from a broker site, not HARERA.

checks.web: RERA possession date 30-Jun-2026 (Houssed, via search snippet); expected possession August 2026 (broker site)
checks.note: Our date matches the marketed date and is 2 months after the reported RERA date.

checks.web: ₹1.25–8.35 Cr (Houssed); ₹46 L–2.07 Cr (Square Yards, from 200 sq ft shops)
checks.note: Houssed's ₹1.25 Cr is within 15% of ours. The sources disagree: Square Yards lists small shops from ₹46 L.

checks.web: Shops and showrooms of 300–2,000 sq ft (Houssed); retail shops of 200–900 sq ft and 1,200 sq ft studios (Square Yards)
858 units; 1 tower (Houssed) or 6 blocks R1–R6 (Square Yards); 4-level retail with a multiplex and food court on the 3rd–4th floors
checks.note: Sources describe 4 retail levels, and our '6' may be the 6 blocks (R1–R6) rather than floors.
